Lofnir Drothkeepers.text:
When you pick the Khazalite Holds faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Lofnir Drothkeepers Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Khazalite Holds faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the DROTHKEEPERS keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Auric Runefather on Magmadroth
Auric Runesmiter on Magmadroth
Auric Runeson on Magmadroth
Auric Runemaster
Auric Runesmiter
Auric Runeson
Vulkyn Flameseekers
Ormyr and Ashtongue
You cannot include Regiments of Renown or faction terrain
REGIMENT OPTIONS
DROTHKEEPERS AURIC RUNESON and AURIC RUNESMITER units can be added to regiments led by a DROTHKEEPERS AURIC RUNEFATHER ON MAGMADROTH.

battle_traits.name: Daring Tamers
battle_traits.effect: Enemy MONSTERS have STRIKE-LAST while they are in combat with 2 or more friendly DROTHKEEPERS Vulkyn Flameseekers units.

battle_traits.name: Skilled Drothwranglers
battle_traits.effect: The timing of friendly Auric Runeson on Magmadroth units' 'Packdroth' ability is 'Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for this unit' instead of 'Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a MOVE ability for this unit in your movement phase'.

battle_traits.name: Ferocious Heat
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly DROTHKEEPERS MONSTER that has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target
battle_traits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

battle_traits.name: Rearing Strike
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly DROTHKEEPERS MONSTER that has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Roll 2 dice. Add 2 to each roll if the target is a MONSTER. For each 5+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

battle_traits.name: Searing Claws
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly DROTHKEEPERS MONSTER that has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target
battle_traits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target that enemy unit.

battle_traits.name: Blazing Vengeance
battle_traits.effect: Each time a friendly DROTHKEEPERS MONSTER is slain, give 1 grudge mark to each friendly DROTHKEEPERS unit within 6" of it.

entries.name: Breath of Vulcatrix
entries.declare: Pick a friendly DROTHKEEPERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly DROTHKEEPERS MONSTER wholly within 12" of them to be a target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the Damage characteristic of the target's Roaring Fyrestream is 3 instead of D3.

entries.name: Summon Molten Infernoth
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Molten Infernoth on the battlefield, pick a friendly DROTHKEEPERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Molten Infernoth wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

runewright > Rhythmic Hammering.timing: Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability from the 'Reverberations of the Runes' or the 'Resonance of the Runes' for this unit

Marks of Vulcatrix > Aureate Hide.effect: After that FIGHT ability has been resolved, if any enemy models were slain by that FIGHT ability, you can pick a visible friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS PRIEST wholly within 12" of this unit. Give that PRIEST D3 ritual points.

Vulkyn Gifts > Fury of Vulcatrix.declare: Pick a friendly GRIMMDRON PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly GRIMMDRON unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Vulkyn Gifts > Ichor of the Ur-Salamande.declare: Pick a friendly GRIMMDRON PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly GRIMMDRON unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
Vulkyn Gifts > Ichor of the Ur-Salamande.effect:
If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:
• If the target is a MONSTER, each time its 'Volcanic Blood' ability would inflict 1 mortal damage on an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage instead.
• If the target is a non‑MONSTER unit, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets that unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

Vulkyn Gifts > Blazing Impetus.declare: Pick a friendly GRIMMDRON PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly GRIMMDRON unit that was not set up this turn and that is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
